summary: Read a string S that contains only lowercase letters and whose length is from 1 to 500. Divide S into contiguous pieces and use as many pieces as the following rule allows. Each letter of the alphabet may occur in at most one piece, even when that letter is repeated inside its own piece. Keep the original left-to-right order of the text. Write the number of characters in each piece.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
